title: Apple iPhone 16
description: 6.1-inch OLED display, A18 chip, 48MP main camera, USB-C, and the Action button. The compact 2024 iPhone, sold from 128GB.

title: Apple iPhone 16 Plus
description: 6.7-inch OLED display, A18 chip, and a larger battery than the iPhone 16. 48MP camera, USB-C, and a brighter screen for outdoor use.

title: Apple iPhone 16 Pro
description: 6.3-inch ProMotion display, A18 Pro chip, titanium frame, and a 48MP camera with 5x tetraprism zoom. Camera Control sits on the side.

title: Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max
description: 6.9-inch ProMotion OLED, A18 Pro, titanium design, and the longest battery in the iPhone 16 line. 48MP camera with 5x optical-range zoom.

title: Apple iPhone 15
description: 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display, A16 chip, Dynamic Island, and a 48MP main camera. USB-C replaced the Lightning port on this 2023 model.

title: Samsung Galaxy S24
description: 6.2-inch Dynamic AMOLED, Galaxy AI tools, and a 50MP main camera. The compact 2024 Galaxy flagship, with seven years of OS updates promised by Samsung.

title: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
description: 6.8-inch QHD display, built-in S Pen, titanium frame, and a 200MP main camera. The Ultra adds a 5x optical zoom and the brightest Galaxy S24 screen.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold6
description: Book-style foldable with a 7.6-inch inner display and a 6.3-inch cover screen. Slimmer than the Fold5, with a 50MP camera and desktop-style multitasking.

title: Google Pixel 9 Pro XL
description: 6.8-inch Super Actua display, Tensor G4, and a triple camera with 5x telephoto. The largest Pixel 9, with Gemini features and a seven-year update promise.

title: Google Pixel 8a
description: 6.1-inch 120Hz OLED, Tensor G3, and a 64MP main camera. The cheaper Pixel still gets the same seven-year update promise and strong night photos.

title: Xiaomi 14
description: 6.36-inch LTPO OLED, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, and Leica-tuned 50MP cameras. A compact 2024 flagship with 90W charging. Model number 23116PN5BC.

title: Nothing Phone (2)
description: 6.7-inch OLED, Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1, and the Glyph light interface on the transparent back. Nothing OS stays close to a clean Android install.

title: Nothing Phone (1)
description: 6.55-inch OLED, Snapdragon 778G+, and the first Glyph light interface. A transparent-back Nothing phone with a 50MP main camera.

title: Fairphone 5
description: 6.46-inch OLED phone designed to be opened and repaired at home. 50MP camera, a user-replaceable battery, and a long software-support promise.

title: Motorola Edge 50 Neo
description: 6.4-inch pOLED display, Dimensity 7300 chip, and a 50MP camera. A smaller Edge with IP68 protection and fast charging.

title: Samsung Galaxy A55
description: 6.6-inch Super AMOLED, 50MP camera, and a metal frame. A midrange Galaxy with stereo speakers and several years of security updates.

title: ASUS ROG Phone 8 Pro
description: 6.78-inch 165Hz AMOLED, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, and a vapor-chamber cooling system. The Pro edition is built for long game sessions.

title: CMF Phone 1
description: 6.67-inch 120Hz AMOLED from Nothing’s CMF brand. MediaTek Dimensity 7300, a 50MP camera, and a screw-on back for accessory plates.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip6
description: Clamshell foldable with a 6.7-inch inner AMOLED and a 3.4-inch cover screen. It folds flat, runs Galaxy AI, and fits into a small pocket.

title: Sony Xperia 1 VI
description: 6.5-inch OLED that can run at 120Hz, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, and a true optical zoom camera. Built for manual photo and video controls.
